questions.question: Which programming language runs natively inside modern web browsers?
What does HTTP status code 401 represent?
What is a closure in JavaScript, and what is its primary use case?
questions.expectedAnswer: A function bundled with references to its surrounding lexical environment; allows access to an outer function's scope from an inner function and data privacy.

questions.question: Explain the key differences between SQL (Relational) and NoSQL (Document-based) databases in terms of schema, scaling, and ACID transactions.
questions.expectedAnswer: SQL databases are relational, structured with predefined schemas, vertically scalable, and prioritize ACID compliance. NoSQL document databases are flexible, schema-agnostic, horizontally scalable across nodes, and often prioritize BASE/eventual consistency.

questions.question: Describe the complete lifecycle of an HTTP/HTTPS GET request from the moment a user presses Enter on the browser address bar until the webpage is rendered on the screen.
questions.expectedAnswer: DNS resolution (browser cache, OS cache, resolver, root/TLD/authoritative nameservers) -> TCP 3-way handshake -> TLS 1.3 cryptographic handshake -> HTTP GET request dispatched -> Server routing, controller, DB query, response generation -> HTTP 200 with HTML headers -> Browser parsing DOM tree -> CSSOM construction -> Render tree -> Layout (reflow) -> Painting and compositing -> JavaScript execution.
